verdict.rationale: cubic documents natural-language operation in PR comments: users can tag @cubic-dev-ai or reply to its comments to ask questions, trigger reviews and request fixes, and replies teach it to behave differently next time. Through its MCP server, a coding agent can also request reviews, triage issues and manage subscription and seats on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on confirmation that the comment and MCP commands work as described, and no evidence that configuration (cubic.yaml, custom agents) can be set by natural language rather than by editing files or the UI.
